# semaphore_ex_project_template_publish (Action)

Publishes the current template configuration as an immutable version. An identical published snapshot is reused by the server. Invoked explicitly or through an action trigger; planning and refreshing do not publish.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "semaphore_ex_project_template_publish" "release" {
  config {
    project_id  = 1
    template_id = 2
  }
}

# Publish explicitly with:
# terraform apply -invoke=action.semaphore_ex_project_template_publish.release
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (Number) Project owning the template.
- `template_id` (Number) Template to publish.
